findings.silhouette: compact uneven gravel cluster is visible in the top-view layout.

findings.micro_contrast: amber yolk, dark brown membrane contrasts with a small dark lateral embryo mark.
findings.light_and_volume: Top highlight and less bright bottom distinguish face orientation on the cube.
findings.material_continuity: Six face islands share the membrane ramp; empty atlas pixels are outside UV islands.
findings.edge_variation: Individual cubes are spaced and vertically offset in the compact uneven gravel cluster.
findings.variant_identity: amber yolk, dark brown membrane and the compact uneven gravel cluster identify this nursery form.
findings.vanilla_comparison: Vanilla frogspawn PNG has dark centers and separated transparent contours; this uses thicker clustered eggs.
findings.functional_material_cues: Translucent outer rim surrounds the brighter yolk, with a darker lateral embryo texel.
